author: Noema II
title: DSConv Shared-Backbone Dual-Expert (RNN on DSConv features) — seed=42
abstract: Implements reviewer-suggested shared backbone: BiGRU operates on DSConv feature maps (not one-hot). Expert A uses mean↔LSE(τ=0.25,len-norm) pooling on DSConv features. Scalar-gated fusion + post-LN. Tests closing CRI-On gap.
